The day of the Mainichi Okan. The crowd's 
attention was fixed entirely on the fierce 
clash between Mejiro Ardan, Oguri Cap, and 
Inari One—

Meanwhile, Mejiro Ardan mentions the 
growing trend of referring to Oguri Cap, 
Super Creek, and Inari One as the "Eternal 
Big Three."

Believing it was a label well worth 
overturning, Mejiro Ardan bared her 
fighting spirit and headed into a race 
where one of the Big Three awaited.
